title: Halo Dental press & news
description: Warm stone editorial press list: a section header with an outlined 'View Media Room' button, full-width hairline-divided article rows (16:9 media/logo card, title, summary, and 32px white square arrow button), a faded fourth preview row under a gradient mask, and a centred 'View more' button.
notes: fadeLast (on by default) applies Halo's soft bottom fade over the last article row above the 'View more' button
each item accepts a custom media ReactNode or renders a clean typographic publication card / studio placeholder
